rxode2ll 2.0.15
text: CRAN release: 2026-07-17 Fix signed integer overflow: loop indices llikXxxInternal() Rcpp functions changed int R_xlen_t; previously vectors longer ~500 million elements (>4 GB) cause undefined behavior due int overflow assigned x.size(). Fix undefined behavior unchecked double--int casts discrete distribution count arguments (x, size) exceeding INT_MAX (2147483647); five affected C-API functions (rxLlikPois, rxLlikBinom, rxLlikGeom, rxLlikNbinom, rxLlikNbinomMu) now return NA instead invoking undefined behavior --range inputs. Fix type correctness loop indices Stan autodiff functor operator() methods across 15 distributions: changed int Eigen::Index match return type Eigen::VectorXd::size(). Add comprehensive derivative validation tests using central finite differences 14 differentiable distributions. Add integer overflow bounds-checking tests 5 discrete distributions, calling *Internal() C++ functions directly bypass R-level input validation. Add skip()-guarded large-vector test documents R_xlen_t fix can run manually systems >4 GB free RAM. Changed _log() _lpmf()/_lpdf() functions changed StanHeaders
